name: Kubernetes tools
description: Installs kubectl, plus optional extensions (helm, kustomize, oc, kubeconform, pluto, conftest), each verified against its published sha256.

version.description: kubectl version to install (e.g. 1.31.0), or 'latest' (the current stable release).

extensions.description: Comma-separated extensions from the supported set: conftest, helm, kubeconform, kustomize, oc, pluto. Append :version to pin one (e.g. helm:3.16.2,oc:stable-4.16). Empty installs none; an unknown name fails the install.
